steps.domain_action: The primordial silence before the first revelation in the Cave of Hira.
The prophet retreats to the cave in search of spiritual clarity.
The Archangel Jibril descends with the command to recite.
The prophet recognizes his own role as the chosen messenger.
The current revelation connects to the previous messages of Ibrahim and Musa.
The revelation branches into specific legal rulings and universal moral truths.
The believers accept the legislative branch as divine guidance.
The skeptics challenge the historical narratives within the parables.
The diverse verses integrate into a single, non-contradictory religious system.
The message exists simultaneously as eternal speech and temporal sound.
The revelation is recorded on parchment and in the hearts of the companions.
The death of the prophet marks the absolute closure of the prophetic gate.
